description: Compile and plan a TuttiCode program without rendering audio (fast, free, deterministic; the same engine as tuttidaw.com/code). Returns diagnostics with line/col and a fix hint, the tempo and loop length, every voice (notes, pitch range, notes per bar, polyphony, instrument and effects with params, gain, pan) and mix warnings (pitch clashes per beat, voices masking each other in one register, crowded low end, extreme densities, gain staging that may clip). Call it after every edit, before code_render. Runs locally: tutticode renders in your own browser with the tuttidaw.com/code engine (free).

bpm.description: Tempo when the code sets none with setcpm/setcps (default 120).

code.description: A TuttiCode program (Strudel-compatible pattern code with TuttiDAW extensions .inst/.fx/.midifx), at most 20,000 characters.

name: code_check
title: Check TuttiCode
